flows.title: Point a domain at a Hostinger site with nameservers
steps: In hPanel, open Websites and select the site.
Next to the temporary domain, or the "Domain not connected" notice, click Check guide.
Copy the two nameserver values shown. Hostinger assigns unique nameservers per site, so take them from hPanel rather than from another guide.

At the domain's registrar, open its DNS or nameserver settings, replace the existing nameservers with those values and save. A domain registered with Hostinger on the same account needs no change, and DNS changes can take up to 24 to 48 hours to spread.
